request.style: English, soaring female solo with ethereal choir, harp, flute, strings, organ, timpani, triumphant and majestic, 110 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Most High is to be feared,
A great King over all the earth.
He subdues peoples under us,
Nations beneath our feet.

[Pre-Chorus]
He chooses our inheritance,
The pride of Jacob, whom he loves.

[Chorus]
Sing praises to God, sing praises!
Sing praises to our King, sing praises!
For God is King of all the earth,
Sing praises with a skillful song.

[Verse]
God has ascended amid shouts,
The LORD amid the blast of the horn.
Joy fills the air in celebration,
The trumpet calls the faithful on.

[Chorus]
Sing praises to God, sing praises!
Sing praises to our King, sing praises!
For God is King of all the earth,
Sing praises with a skillful song.

[Bridge]
God reigns over the nations,
Seated on his holy throne.
The nobles of the peoples gather,
With the people of the God of Abraham.

[Chorus]
Sing praises to God, sing praises!
Sing praises to our King, sing praises!
For God is King of all the earth,
Sing praises with a skillful song.

[Outro]
The shields of the earth belong to God,
He is highly exalted.
